visual_action: The video first shows President Joe Biden at an outdoor Halloween event, giving candy to two children in costume. It then cuts to a clip of former President Donald Trump and Melania Trump at a similar event, where Trump places a candy bar on the head of a child wearing an inflatable Minion costume.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Shown in the first half of the video interacting with children, and identified by the on-screen text 'President Biden'.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Shown in the second half of the video placing candy on a child's costume. Identified by face and the on-screen text 'the last guy'.

cast.name: Melania Trump
cast.evidence: Shown standing next to Donald Trump during the Halloween event.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official account @democrats.

on_screen_text.text: While the last guy was only up to tricks

spoken_summary: There is no dialogue in the video; it is set entirely to music.
audio_music: The video is set to the Britney Spears song 'Toxic,' an upbeat and dramatic electronic pop track that plays throughout.
editing_pacing: A simple edit consisting of a single cut from a clip of Joe Biden to a clip of Donald Trump.
central_claim: President Biden benevolently gives out treats, whereas his predecessor Donald Trump played mean-spirited tricks.
intended_effect: To make the viewer see Joe Biden as kind and normal, while portraying Donald Trump as cruel or oafish, in order to build support for Biden and opposition to Trump.
